Cost: 1 holy pool point

Benefit: As a swift action, the paladin unleashes a wave of holy energy on her next successful attack on an enemy, dealing 1d6 points of holy damage + an additional 1d6 per two paladin levels to the enemy and all enemies in a 20-ft.-line. All enemies except the target in the area of effect must make a Reflex save (DC 10 + half of the paladin's level + her Charisma modifier) to reduce the damage by half.
